title: POS high-volume product search performance hardening

performanceTarget.target: sub-200ms indexed search on normal deployment conditions
performanceTarget.strategy: tenant/status composite indexes, Postgres trigram indexes for contains search, keyset cursor pagination, 24-row UI pages, 50-row API cap

checks.name: schema_has_composite_product_search_indexes
checks.details: Product model should expose tenant/status/search-field composite indexes.

checks.name: migration_adds_postgres_trigram_search_indexes
checks.details: Postgres trigram indexes support fast contains-style POS search for large catalogs.

checks.name: pos_search_api_uses_keyset_pagination
checks.details: POS product search should page forward with a cursor instead of offset or full-catalog loads.

checks.name: pos_search_api_is_tenant_scoped_bounded_and_active_only
checks.details: The endpoint must stay permissioned, tenant-scoped, active-only, and capped to 50 rows per call.

checks.name: pos_search_api_orders_stably_for_cursor
checks.details: Cursor pagination needs stable ordering so the next page is deterministic.

checks.name: pos_dashboard_uses_bounded_search_endpoint
checks.details: POS UI should load small pages from POS-specific search and append only on request.

checks.name: pos_dashboard_keeps_debounce
checks.details: Typing in the cashier search field should remain debounced.

checks.name: pos_pagination_styles_present
checks.details: Load-more control should have stable layout styling.

checks.name: package_exposes_hal148_verifier
checks.details: HAL-148 verification must be runnable from npm scripts.
